caption: The image shows a single ornate teapot with a rounded body, wide base, and a pronounced spout and handle. The teapot has a decorative lid with a finial on top and floral motifs around its rim and base. The handle and spout are elaborately shaped, with the handle featuring a jagged, almost branch-like design and the spout curving upwards with a textured surface. The body of the teapot is decorated with a central rectangular scene depicting a group of people and two horses in front of a large, multi-story building with classical architectural features such as columns, dormer windows, and a central cupola. Above this building, the words "ALMS HOUSE" are visible. The colors in the image are rendered in sepia tones, suggesting the image is monochrome or an old photograph, with dominant shades of brown and beige. The floral decorations encircle the scene on the body and are also present along the base, blending the ornamental motifs with the central architectural depiction. The teapot is placed on a plain, light-colored surface against a similarly light background.
title: Teapot - "Baltimore Almshouse"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
